lifecycle_contract.output_bound: Conservative lzma_stream_buffer_bound allowance for persistent update/finalize encoding; zero or overflow bounds are unsupported
lifecycle_contract.return_length: Actual out_pos delta for every update/finalize call; capacity is never charged
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: Stable tscb_status_v1; LZMA_BUF_ERROR maps to DST_TOO_SMALL; malformed/truncated/nonexact streams map to CODEC_ERROR
lifecycle_contract.update: One lzma_easy_buffer_encode with preset 0-9 and LZMA_CHECK_NONE; writes block/index/footer before returning
lifecycle_contract.finalize: Mandatory lzma_code(LZMA_FINISH) loop until stream end; repeated finalize rejected
lifecycle_contract.decode: Fresh lzma_stream_decoder with 1 GiB memlimit and flags 0; lzma_code LZMA_FINISH until STREAM_END; exact descriptor output and complete input required
lifecycle_contract.reset: NEW_CONTEXT_PER_INDEPENDENT_OBJECT; C ABI reset clears state and native timing counters

stream_components.outer_container: TSCB 12-byte prefix and canonical JSON descriptors
stream_components.container: XZ header/footer bytes excluding their CRCs
stream_components.metadata: Descriptor JSON and block header excluding CRC; serialized LZMA2 properties included
stream_components.index: Complete mandatory XZ index excluding its CRC, including internal padding
stream_components.checksum: Header, footer, index and block-header CRC32; never reported as zero merely because data check is NONE
stream_components.payload: LZMA2 compressed data charged to routed bucket

-O1 -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fsanitize=address,undefined; same scalar single-thread dependency configuration and local ELF function binding

known_limitations: Spreadsheet Value-Compress!B9 lists LZMA / xz. The registered xz profile uses persistent lzma_code() LZMA2 contexts; raw LZMA/.lzma, EXTREME, BCJ/delta, dictionaries and multithreading remain unregistered.

lzbench uses multithreaded stream encoding/decoding and decoder LZMA_CONCATENATED | LZMA_IGNORE_CHECK. This project uses one thread, one persistent stream context, conservative output bounds and strict decoder flags 0. Native timing is not lzbench-equivalent.
Streaming encoding uses lzma_easy_encoder plus lzma_code(LZMA_RUN/LZMA_FINISH); native timing includes intrinsic allocation and finalization within those calls.

No data checksum matches lzbench's setting; structural CRC32 remains mandatory and charged. Payload corruption with unchanged structure is caught by framework exact correctness, not guaranteed by an absent data checksum.
Only zero blocks for empty input or one LZMA2 block otherwise is registered. Concatenated streams, stream padding, alternate filters/checks and unexpected block count are rejected.
Decoder memory limit is 1 GiB; worker resource isolation remains separately enforced. Index presence does not advertise random access or query capability.

Clean upstream comparison 9fc6f5cd8774ebef8d4e030f7081fb6984c0dc3f also reports 5.8.3 but differs in index/stream-buffer decoder/API/hardware files. No sources are mixed; lzma2_encoder.c is byte-identical.
LeakSanitizer is disabled under host ptrace policy; ASan/UBSan remain enabled. XZ_SANDBOX=no affects unused vendor CLI build configuration, not Python framework process isolation.
Default VALUE national_illness formal qualification does not claim formal performance coverage of every dataset, track or preset.
